owner_direction.taste: keep the character art (deform/animate only); forecasts unchanged; live strikes are the approved black-blood ScarletInk; seals stay; no silk/thread/fibre language; no beat-driven motion; refined, red/magical, painterly, never a flat fill, restrained rather than loud; decoration never looks like extra danger, never covers forecasts; Reduced Effects keeps timing readability

review_fixes.crown_and_mantle_rims: only the art's red paint emits (Paint from its redness), so the Crown's black leg thorns and the Mantle's dark cloth no longer get red outlines (Crown legs, frames 126/136: black-to-red pixels 708/1641 -> 0/54; Mantle at Fire 2615 -> 176); the lip is a soft gradient against the mean of four neighbours
review_fixes.crown_front: light on the painted cloth (its own folds and embroidery), not a peach wash; fades with Ignite
review_fixes.darkening: only Drain darkens, by .25; the warning's Heat no longer darkens the cloth under forecasts
review_fixes.hearts: the attack changes a heart only over the painted body (eroded alpha mask of the patch): beat on the attack clock, the Mantle's tightened spiral and a capped swell of its own red instead of a lilac-white spike (Mantle heart box at Fire: near-white 131 -> 773 before, 124 -> 198 after the first fix); the Choir's core is masked by its torso and its outer glow and patch keep the accepted values
review_fixes.choir_blood: no knot on the thin heart-to-hand flow; the sent blood stays inside the painted limb below the white-hot threshold (.7 < .75), only the struck fingertips ignite; sent and returning blood scale with Gain so the arm never steps on Fire; Reduced writes the same front and vertices and the shader quiets only the new light (Calm)
review_fixes.vespera: the reactor keeps today's recoil impulse: no four-point flare on every Fire (orb crop, frame 134: near-white 1361 -> 459 px)
review_fixes.mantle_light: seams .65, bone heat run .4 and blanch .35 (quieter, and the forecast's local contrast over the Mantle holds 0.91)
review_fixes.membership: the expression follows roster membership (alive or Down), so death and revival no longer snap a swinging body back to rest; viewers outside the fight see today's picture, the Choir's accepted cues included
review_fixes.past_poses: the Crown and Mantle keep notes closed within 21 ticks so the wake replays the motion the body really made; current-tick consumers read only notes that hold the tick (domain-tested)
